system.description:
Cursed item (seems Dust of Disappearance). Thrown, each creature within 30ft makes a Fortitude save or is Incapacitated, choking, until it saves at the end of a turn.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
One use. Thrown up (an action), it makes you and all within 10ft Invisible for 2d4 minutes, even when attacking or casting.

Rarity: Uncommon
